scope: read-only audit of existing evaluator/tap/trajectory/branching artifacts; no new experiments; no checkpoint changes

operational_definition.weak_claim: Looped-model hidden states expose readable process-quality signals about the model's own ongoing computation.
requirements: readable internal signal recovered by a tiny external readout
about the model's own ongoing computation (success/quality of its own trajectory)
present in intermediate hidden states (loops/prefix), not only the final token
before or not reducible to final external judgment
explicitly_not_claimed: external evaluator capability equated with model self-knowledge
autonomous internal use of the signal for self-control

pillars.name: Prediction
pillars.caveats: trajectory cell n small (20 tasks / 41 comparisons in best cell); preference is fixed-order; long prefixes may include partial answer
pillars.allowed_claim: Frozen Ouro hidden states contain readable information that predicts human-preference ordering and eventual branch success via a tiny antisymmetric/relational readout.

pillars.name: Timing

key_numbers.feature_shape: [3 layers x 4 loops x 2048] captured at prefix position

pillars.caveats: predictor reads prefix-position states and predicts continuations not yet generated (genuine pre-completion); but long prefixes on short tasks can contain the answer and no strictly-pre-answer-token control exists yet
pillars.allowed_claim: Predictive signal is present in intermediate loop states and partial-trajectory prefixes, including short (32-64 token) prefixes preceding most of the answer; partial pre-answer evidence, not airtight.

pillars.name: Specificity
pillars.caveats: relational/antisymmetry/label-separation controls strong; length/logprob/prompt-family/domain shortcuts not run as comparators for branch-success predictor
pillars.allowed_claim: The preference signal is relational and order-sensitive (not pointwise quality, not constant-output, not pair-order artifact); trivial-shortcut controls for the success predictor are incomplete.

pillars.name: Utility
pillars.caveats: forced top1 is diagnostic; survivor-set retention is the headline; CoreContent in-dist edge ~half constructed-negative artifact (real-negative +0.063), drops to 0.417 OOD
pillars.allowed_claim: Signal is useful for external ranking, retention, survivor-set pruning, and diagnosis (weak utility). End-to-end capability gain over sampling not shown (strong utility unproven).

pillars.name: Role separation
pillars.allowed_claim: Validity/survivability (DualAnchor), relational content quality (CoreContent), and correctness (external verifier) are empirically and conceptually distinct; tap scores are not correctness labels.

pillars.name: Cross-domain
pillars.caveats: single universal head weak; HH->code transfer weak; code-specific heads win on code; science diagnostic-only; coding-correctness transfer fails
pillars.allowed_claim: Readable process-quality signal is not HH-only; it appears across objective domains but is best read by domain-specialized heads, not one universal probe.

pillars.name: Control boundary
pillars.caveats: 'closed under tested methods' is a bounded negative, not impossibility; training-time integration (S3A) untested
pillars.allowed_claim: Hidden states are readable (readout exists), but no tested frozen-backbone steering produced reliable write-control; readout and autonomous control are different problems; control requires training-time integration.

minimal_remaining_controls.name: pre-answer leakage audit
minimal_remaining_controls.question: Does branch-success prediction survive when the readout sees only hidden states captured strictly before any answer token is emitted?
minimal_remaining_controls.estimated_cost: CPU hours or <1 GPU-hour if recapture needed
minimal_remaining_controls.pass_criterion: pairwise acc and top1 lift stay above random and shortcut baselines at strictly-pre-answer cut
minimal_remaining_controls.effect_on_claim: converts P2 PARTIAL->STRONG; timing verdict -> STRONG_PREANSWER_CONTROLLED

minimal_remaining_controls.name: shortcut baseline audit
minimal_remaining_controls.question: Does the hidden-state probe beat simple baselines: length, domain, prompt family, candidate source, logprob/entropy?
input_artifacts: logprobs from existing continuations or tiny re-score
minimal_remaining_controls.pass_criterion: hidden-state probe lift exceeds every simple baseline lift
minimal_remaining_controls.effect_on_claim: converts P3 PARTIAL->STRONG or honestly downgrades prediction claim

minimal_remaining_controls.name: task-grouped heldout audit
minimal_remaining_controls.question: Does prediction survive when train/test split by task/prompt family (no task in both)?
minimal_remaining_controls.pass_criterion: pairwise acc stays above chance under task-grouped heldout

minimal_remaining_controls.name: optional Barbados replication
minimal_remaining_controls.question: Do Barbados loop states predict final exactness / boundary failure / repair?
input_artifacts: Barbados modular-expr harness (capability-replication only; NO loop-state introspection result currently exists)
minimal_remaining_controls.estimated_cost: modest GPU; only if Barbados already instruments loop-state dumps
minimal_remaining_controls.pass_criterion: loop-state probe predicts final exactness above chance
